title: Understanding Social Anomie
text:
Anomie, a concept popularized by Émile Durkheim, describes a state of normlessness within a society. It occurs when established social norms lose their collective power or become unclear due to rapid societal change, economic upheaval, or sudden shifts in cultural expectations.

The absence of clear regulatory guidelines leaves individuals feeling unanchored and detached from the community structure. This condition increases feelings of alienation and can contribute significantly to various forms of deviance, including increased rates of suicide (a phenomenon Durkheim analyzed extensively) and social unrest.
